questions.q: Into how many octants do the three coordinate planes divide space?
questions.explanation: Each axis divides space into two parts, giving 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.

questions.q: What is the distance between (1, 2, 3) and (4, 6, 15)?
Which form do the coordinates of a point on the z-axis take?
questions.explanation: The x and y coordinates are zero.

questions.q: What is the distance of the point (2, 3, 6) from the origin?
What is the midpoint of (2, 4, 6) and (4, 6, 8)?
How many coordinate planes are there?
questions.explanation: The xy, yz and zx planes.
